partner_results_applied.application: proved its Z=2r score is globally optimal among every capped-basis distribution for r>=1 under its row-cap hypothesis
after aggregating the extreme shear with a collinear product bank, obtained continuous density <=27/2^(4/3)<10.715 on the exact target family

new_results.statement: For L=[u,V^T], V^TV=I3, ||u||=r, every capped-basis law has Z_w<=exp(h(beta))r^(2beta), beta<=1/2; hence Z_w<=1+r^2 for r<=1 and Z_w<=2r for r>=1.
For the exact target family Q_r=2S_rY_2+Y_3^2 with three disjoint flat-three banks and S_r=(rX0+Y1)/sqrt(1+r^2), the density is continuous and uniformly <=27/2^(4/3)<10.715 for all r>0.

unresolved_implication: For an arbitrary Schur-isotropic large-shear frame, convert degeneration of capped-basis determinant entropy into a genuine original-coordinate aggregate aligned with the shear direction and independent of a transverse two-bank smoother, or route the failure to an existing heavy-row/physical-pair/ridge branch.
